stem: Which statement describes why the U.S. military developed protective masks during World War I?

options.label: A
options.text: The masks were needed to stop enemy forces from recognizing commanding officers.

options.label: B
options.text: The masks were needed to prevent soldiers from breathing in smoke from the battlefields.

options.label: C
options.text: The masks were needed to lessen the smell of sewer gas for soldiers in the trenches.

options.label: D
options.text: The masks were needed to shield soldiers from chemical weapons used in the war.
